INSIDE SHIELDBRAIN01 / 03

Screenshot 1 of 3: The counter

01

Notice the habit.

See how many short videos you watch in a session. A small moment of awareness goes a long way.

02

Choose your stopping point.

Set a video limit before you start. When you reach it, ShieldBrain interrupts the Reels screen.

03

Stay connected.

Keep access to your direct messages, stories, and main feed while putting a boundary around Reels.

Designed to keep screen content on your device+

ShieldBrain uses Android’s Accessibility Service to detect the Reels screen and apply the protections you enable. This permission is required for those protections. ShieldBrain does not collect, record, store, transmit, or share screen content. Data used for this functionality stays on your device.

02 / BUILT WITH INTENTION

Less autopilot.
More living.

Your phone should fit into your life. Not take it over.

ShieldBrain is built by LunarForge, an independent app studio. We believe a useful tool starts with a real frustration and gives you a clear way forward.

ShieldBrain is our first step: a simple way to be more intentional about short videos. One small app, built around a very human problem.
